invariants.description: O2 content matches the exact solution C_ss + (C_init - C_ss) exp(-v t/q_0) (v = settled terminal flow; tolerance 0.2% of the step plus 5e-5 ml/ml for the ~10 ms flow start-up of the harness)
CO2 content matches the exact solution
O2 mass balance: q_0 C changes by the time integral of v (C_a - C) + M_O2 (trapezoid on the logged flow, from t = 0.5 s after the flow start-up)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((q_0*C_O2_p - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*np.diff(t)*((term__v_T*(C_O2_a - C_O2_p) + M_O2)[1:] + (term__v_T*(C_O2_a - C_O2_p) + M_O2)[:-1])))))[t >= 0.5] - (q_0*C_O2_p - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*np.diff(t)*((term__v_T*(C_O2_a - C_O2_p) + M_O2)[1:] + (term__v_T*(C_O2_a - C_O2_p) + M_O2)[:-1])))))[t >= 0.5][0])) <= 2e-3*max(np.ptp(q_0*C_O2_p), abs(M_O2)*1e-3)

bc_sweep.rationale: Arterial contents span hypoxaemic to hyperoxic blood (0.10-0.21 ml/ml O2; 0.40-0.56 ml/ml CO2, Spencer curve at P_CO2 25-60 mmHg); q_0 spans 50-500 ml tissue compartments; M spans 1.2-18 ml/min per compartment. With v = 4e-6 m3/s the lowest steady O2 content in the sweep is 0.10 - 1.8e-7/4e-6 = 0.055 ml/ml, so contents stay positive (the model has no floor: C_O2 would go negative if |M_O2| > v C_O2_a).

baseline.reason: candidate: brain arterio-venous O2 content difference / jugular venous O2 at normal CBF (e.g. albanese2014physiology Table 2-7 consumption rates with a cerebral flow) -- needs a flow value per compartment from the owner

calibrate.note: not_applicable: two-parameter linear mixing compartment; nothing to identify beyond the steady state that the exact-solution invariants already check
